*   Input: A ship specification section (Section 1.2).
    *   Task: Extract explicit, checkable claims.
    *   Output Format: A single valid, parseable JSON object following a specific schema.
    *   Constraints:
        *   No inferred values.
        *   No unit conversions.
        *   `section_id`, `subject`, `quantity`, `value`, `unit`, `quote`.
        *   `quantity` identifies what is measured (width, height, count, etc.).
        *   `quote` must be verbatim.
        *   Return an empty list if no claims.
        *   No Markdown fences, no extra text.

    *   "The described vessel should be classified in the category of up to date Research vessel." (Subjective/Classification, not a specific measurable claim).
    *   "The vessel will be exclusively of innovation type, aluminum alloy construction..." (Material/Type, not a specific quantity/value).
    *   "...equipped with two main engines, marine type diesels..." (Count: 2, Subject: main engines, Unit: count/engines).
    *   "...propulsion will be supplied by two innovate propulsion systems..." (Count: 2, Subject: propulsion systems, Unit: count/systems).
    *   "...achieve the class notation of DP2 a Bow Thruster will be installed." (Count: 1, Subject: Bow Thruster, Unit: count/thruster).
    *   "The vessel will have a continuous Main Deck, extended from stem to stern." (Qualitative).
    *   "Double bottom tanks will be fitted only in bosun store and crew accommodation area and partially in engine room." (Location/Configuration).
    *   "On the main deck Crews' space and service space are provided... They consist of mess-recreation room, galley, two cabins with two beds each..." (Count: 2, Subject: cabins, Unit: count/cabins; Count: 2, Subject: beds per cabin, Unit: count/beds).
    *   "...two cabins with two beds each..." -> This is a specific claim.
